items.title: Evan Christopher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 1, 2009
items.q: those players like Sidney Bechet and Omer Simeon

ctx.x: Right. It was for the Jim Cullum Jazz Band. And it was being able to work six nights a week, it gave me a period of time to switch back and forth until eventually I phased out the Boehm system entirely. But I wasn’t playing — I was still playing the Boehm system when I first moved to New Orleans. I didn’t switch to the Albert system until — I was experimenting with the Albert system in New Orleans.
From a finger standpoint some of the effects and the sounds that those players like Sidney Bechet and Omer Simeon — do you think it helps to have that instrument then?
